exercises.instructionEn: Put the words in the correct order to form questions, as in the example. (7 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: So'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda joylashtirib savol tuzing, namunadagidek. (7 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TARTIBI:
  So'roq so'zi + yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l?

  'be' bilan:      What IS this animal?
  'do/does' bilan: Where DO they LIVE?
  'can' bilan:     What CAN they DO?
  'have got' bilan: HAVE they GOT small fins?

Bu savollar 60-betdagi ko'k kit matniga tegishli —
har bir savolning javobi o'sha matnda bor.

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 — What is this animal?

items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'be' fe'li so'roq so'zidan keyin, egadan oldin.
Javob: It's a blue whale.

So'roq so'zi → DO → ega → fe'l.
Javob: They live in oceans all around the world.

So'roq so'zi → DO → ega → fe'l.
Javob: They eat plankton.

'can' — yordamchi fe'l, 'do' — asosiy fe'l.
Javob: They can swim very fast.

'How much' — og'irlik savoli.
Javob: They weigh up to 150,000 kilos.

'have got' savoli: HAVE + ega + GOT + ot?
'do' KERAK EMAS.
Javob: Yes, they have.

'How long' — davomiylik savoli.
Javob: They live for about 80 years.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word or phrase. (12 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'z yoki iboraning tagiga chizing. (12 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ 5–8 UNITLARNING GRAMMATIKASINI TEKSHIRADI:
  how much / how many
  Present Simple / Present Continuous
  can / can't
  3-shaxs -s
  some / any / a
  chastota ravishlari
  noto'g'ri ko'plik
  vaqt predloglari
  miqdor so'zlari

items.textEn: 1  ............ eggs do we need for the cake?
items.uz: Tort uchun bizga nechta tuxum kerak?
items.whyUz: 'eggs' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.

items.textEn: 2  My sister ............ in the garden at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'My sister' — birlik → IS playing.

items.uz: Baliqlar kuylay olmaydi, qushlar esa suza olmaydi.
items.whyUz:
QOBILIYAT haqida → CAN'T (ikkalasida ham).
'doesn't sing' grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin ma'nosi boshqa
('kuylamaydi', 'kuylay olmaydi' emas).
'birds isn't swim' — mutlaqo XATO.

items.uz: Bobom har kuni kechqurun televizor ko'radi.
items.whyUz:
'every evening' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Grandpa' — birlik 3-shaxs → watchES (-ch → -ES).

'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.
TAKLIF savoli → SOME.

items.textEn: 6  They ............ go to the beach on Mondays.
items.uz: Ular dushanba kunlari hech qachon plyajga bormaydi.
items.whyUz:
'never' = hech qachon (chastota ravishi, tasdiq gapda).
'ever' faqat SAVOL va INKOR gaplarda ishlatiladi:
'Do you ever go ...?'

items.textEn: 7  Have ............ got wings? No, they haven't.
items.whyUz:
'sheep' — NOTO'G'RI ot, ko'pligi ham SHEEP.
'sheeps' XATO.
Javobdagi 'they' ko'plik ekanini ko'rsatadi.

items.textEn: 8  There is ............ milk in the fridge.
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap ('There IS') → SOME.
'any' inkor va savolda.

items.textEn: 9  Susan often goes for long walks ............ spring.
items.uz: Syuzan bahorda ko'pincha uzoq sayr qiladi.
items.whyUz: FASL oldida IN: in spring, in summer, in autumn, in winter.

'Listen!' — AYNI PAYTDA sodir bo'layotgan ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
7-unitdagi 'Be quiet! The baby is sleeping' bilan bir xil holat.

items.textEn: 11  Are there ............ strawberries in the box?
items.whyUz:
MA'LUMOT so'rash savoli → ANY.
'much' sanalmaydigan otlar bilan, 'strawberries' esa sanaladi.

items.textEn: 12  Could I have a ............ of crisps, please?
items.whyUz:
'a packet of crisps' — chips PAKETDA sotiladi.
'a carton' — sut va sharbat uchun.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words and phrases in the lists below to complete the dialogues. (7 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatlardagi so'z va iboralar bilan dialoglarni to'ldiring. (7 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: please, here, can, would

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda) — KIYIM DO'KONIDA:

  A: CAN I help you, madam?
  B: Yes, PLEASE. I'm looking for a summer dress.
  A: What colour WOULD you like?
  B: Blue.
  A: HERE you are.
  B: Can I try it on?
  A: Yes, of course.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Yordam bera olamanmi, xonim?
  B: Ha, iltimos. Men yozgi ko'ylak qidiryapman.
  A: Qanday rangdagisini xohlaysiz?
  B: Ko'k.
  A: Mana, oling.
  B: Kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
  A: Ha, albatta.

Bu dialog 7-unitning 53-betidagi dialog bilan bir xil.

lines.whyUz: 'CAN I help you?' — do'konda sotuvchining odatiy boshlanishi.

lines.textEn: Yes, 2) ............ . I'm looking for a summer dress.
lines.whyUz:
'Yes, PLEASE.' — taklifni QABUL QILISH.
Qabul → PLEASE; rad → THANKS.

'What colour WOULD you like?' = qanday rangdagisini xohlaysiz?
'would like' — muloyim shakl.

'HERE you are.' = Mana, oling.
O'zgarmas ibora.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words and phrases in the lists below to complete the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatlardagi so'z va iboralar bilan dialoglarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: Would you like a, I'm hungry, How about some

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda) — OVQAT TAKLIF QILISH:

  A: I'M HUNGRY. Is there anything to eat?
  B: WOULD YOU LIKE A piece of chocolate cake?
  A: No, thanks. I don't like chocolate cake.
  B: HOW ABOUT SOME apple pie?
  A: Oh, yes, please! I'd love a piece of apple pie.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Qornim ochdi. Yegani bir narsa bormi?
  B: Bir bo'lak shokoladli tort xohlaysizmi?
  A: Yo'q, rahmat. Men shokoladli tortni yoqtirmayman.
  B: Olmali pirog-chi?
  A: Ha, iltimos! Bir bo'lak olmali pirogni juda xohlardim.

Bu dialog 8-unitning 56-betidagi dialog bilan bir xil.

DIQQAT — 'A' va 'SOME':
  'a piece of chocolate cake' — 'a' MIQDOR so'zi oldida
  'some apple pie' — sanalmaydigan ot bilan

lines.whyUz:
'I'm hungry' = Qornim ochdi.
DIQQAT: 'I have hunger' XATO — 'be' + sifat.

'Would you like A piece of ...?' — TAKLIF savoli.
'a piece of cake' — miqdor iborasi.

lines.textEn: No, thanks. I don't like chocolate cake.

lines.hintUz: Birinchi taklif rad etilgach, ikkinchi taklif
lines.whyUz:
'How about SOME apple pie?' — IKKINCHI taklif.
'apple pie' — sanalmaydigan → SOME.

lines.textEn: Oh, yes, please! I'd love a piece of apple pie.

exercises.explanationUz:
SARA MAYLZ HAQIDAGI MAQOLA.

TUZILISHI (5-unitdagi kasb maqolalari kabi):
  1-xatboshi: ism, yosh, kasb + ish haqidagi fikri
  2-xatboshi: kun tartibi (ertalabdan kechgacha)
  3-xatboshi: bo'sh vaqt
  4-xatboshi: hayotidan mamnunligi

Bu tuzilish 9-mashqdagi yozma ish uchun NAMUNA bo'ladi.

sentences.noteUz:
Ism + yosh + kasb — maqolaning standart boshlanishi.
Yosh vergul orasida beriladi.

sentences.en: "I like my job a lot because I love cooking. It is tiring, though, as I work from ten o'clock until eight every day," she says.
sentences.uz: «Menga ishim juda yoqadi, chunki men ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko'raman. Lekin bu charchatadigan ish, chunki men har kuni soat 10 dan 8 gacha ishlayman», — deydi u.
sentences.noteUz:
'though' = lekin (gap O'RTASIDA yoki oxirida).
'as' bu yerda = because (chunki).
'from ... until ...' = ...dan ...gacha.

sentences.en: Sarah is not an early bird. Her day starts at nine o'clock.
sentences.uz: Sara erta turadigan odam emas. Uning kuni soat to'qqizda boshlanadi.

sentences.en: She gets up, has a shower and then drives to work.
sentences.uz: U turadi, dush qabul qiladi va so'ng ishga mashinada boradi.
sentences.noteUz:
'get up' = turmoq; 'have a shower' = dush qabul qilmoq;
'drive to work' = ishga mashinada bormoq.

sentences.en: She arrives at the restaurant at ten o'clock, then she starts making the salads and desserts.
sentences.uz: U restoranga soat o'nda yetib keladi, so'ng salat va shirinliklar tayyorlashni boshlaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'arrive AT + kichik joy' (restoran, bekat).
'start + fe'l-ING' = ...ni boshlamoq.

sentences.en: At half past eleven, she has a break for lunch, then from twelve o'clock until five, she cooks for the customers.
sentences.uz: Soat o'n bir yarimda u tushlik uchun tanaffus qiladi, so'ng o'n ikkidan beshgacha mijozlar uchun ovqat pishiradi.
sentences.noteUz:
'half past eleven' = 11:30.
'have a break' = tanaffus qilmoq.
'a customer' = mijoz.

sentences.en: After that, she cleans the kitchen. She finishes work at eight o'clock, then she meets her friends.
sentences.uz: Shundan keyin u oshxonani tozalaydi. U ishni soat sakkizda tugatadi, so'ng do'stlari bilan uchrashadi.
sentences.noteUz:
'After that' = shundan keyin.
'finish work' = ishni tugatmoq.

sentences.en: They usually go to the cinema or a Chinese restaurant in the evening.
sentences.uz: Ular odatda kechqurun kinoga yoki xitoy restoraniga borishadi.
sentences.noteUz:
'go to the cinema' — THE bilan.
'in the evening' — kun qismi oldida IN.

sentences.en: In her free time, Sarah visits her parents or goes fishing with her brother. She also loves swimming.
sentences.uz: Bo'sh vaqtida Sara ota-onasinikiga boradi yoki akasi bilan baliq ovlaydi. U yana suzishni ham yaxshi ko'radi.
sentences.noteUz:
'in her free time' = bo'sh vaqtida.
'go fishing' = baliq ovlagani bormoq.
'love + fe'l-ING' → 'loves SWIMMING'.

sentences.en: "I've got a great job and I feel very happy with the way I live," says Sarah.
sentences.uz: «Menda ajoyib ish bor va men yashash tarzimdan juda mamnunman», — deydi Sara.
sentences.noteUz:
'happy WITH' = ...dan mamnun.
'the way I live' = yashash tarzim.
'says Sarah' — teskari tartib, iqtibosdan keyin odatiy.

exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni matndan toping.
To'liq gap bilan javob bering.

items.textEn: 1  Does Sarah like her job? Why (not)?
items.answer: Yes, she does. She likes her job a lot because she loves cooking.
items.whyUz:
Sara: 'I like my job a lot because I love cooking.'
SABAB 'because' bilan beriladi.
Iqtibosdagi 'I' → javobda 'she' ga aylanadi.

items.answer: Because she works from ten o'clock until eight every day. She works long hours.
items.whyUz:
Sara: 'It is tiring, though, as I work from ten o'clock until eight every day.'
10:00 dan 20:00 gacha — 10 soat!

items.textEn: 3  What does Sarah do in the morning?
items.answer: She gets up at nine o'clock, has a shower and drives to work. She arrives at the restaurant at ten and starts making the salads and desserts. At half past eleven she has a break for lunch.
items.whyUz:
Matnning ikkinchi xatboshisi — ertalabki qism.
Har bir ish soati bilan berilgan.

items.textEn: 3  What does Sarah do in the afternoon?
items.answer: From twelve o'clock until five she cooks for the customers. After that, she cleans the kitchen.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'from twelve o'clock until five, she cooks for the customers.
After that, she cleans the kitchen.'

items.textEn: 3  What does Sarah do in the evening?
items.answer: She finishes work at eight o'clock, then she meets her friends. They usually go to the cinema or a Chinese restaurant.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'She finishes work at eight o'clock, then she meets her friends.
They usually go to the cinema or a Chinese restaurant in the evening.'

items.textEn: 4  What does Sarah do in her free time?
items.answer: She visits her parents or goes fishing with her brother. She also loves swimming.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'In her free time, Sarah visits her parents or goes fishing
with her brother. She also loves swimming.'

items.textEn: 5  How does she feel about her life?
items.answer: She feels very happy with the way she lives. She thinks she has got a great job.
items.whyUz:
Sara: 'I've got a great job and I feel very happy with the way I live.'
Iqtibosdagi 'I live' → javobda 'she lives'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the plan below to write an article about Fred King's daily routine and his free-time activities. (18 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rejadagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Fred Kingning kun tartibi va bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari haqida maqola yozing. (18 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  Para 1: Fred King, 38, reporter
     'I like my job very much because I love interviewing
      people. It is tiring, though, because I work long hours.'

  Para 2 (kun tartibi):
     • get up at 7 o'clock
     • have a shower / get dressed
     • leave home at 8 o'clock / arrive at the office at 8:30
     • read the morning newspapers
     • have lunch at 12:30
     • in the afternoon / write articles / prepare for his
       TV programme
     • TV programme / finish at 6 o'clock / then meet friends /
       have dinner
     • in the evening / usually / watch TV or listen to music

  Para 3 (bo'sh vaqt):
     • love sailing / not like playing football or basketball /
       go sailing every weekend

  Para 4 (xulosa):
     • 'I have got a great job and I feel very satisfied
        with my life.'

NAMUNA: 8-mashqdagi Sara haqidagi maqola —
u ham AYNAN shu to'rt qismdan iborat.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a reporter = jurnalist, muxbir
  to interview = suhbat olmoq
  to get dressed = kiyinmoq
  an article = maqola
  to prepare for = ...ga tayyorlanmoq
  sailing = yelkanli qayiqda suzish

structure.noteUz:
Sara haqidagi maqola bilan bir xil boshlanish:
'Sarah Miles, 25, is a cook.'

structure.modelEn: "I like my job very much because I love interviewing people. It is tiring, though, because I work long hours," he says.
structure.noteUz:
Rejadagi iqtibos aynan ko'chiriladi.
'though' = lekin (gap o'rtasida).

structure.modelEn: Fred gets up at seven o'clock. He has a shower and gets dressed. He leaves home at eight o'clock and arrives at the office at half past eight. Then he reads the morning newspapers.
structure.noteUz:
'get dressed' = kiyinmoq.
8:30 → 'half past eight'.
'arrive AT the office' — 'at' predlogi.

structure.modelEn: He has lunch at half past twelve. In the afternoon, he writes articles and prepares for his TV programme.
His TV programme finishes at six o'clock, then he meets his friends and has dinner. In the evening, he usually watches TV or listens to music.
structure.noteUz:
Birlik ega → -S: finisheS, meetS, haS, watcheS, listenS.
'listen TO music' — 'to' shart.

structure.modelEn: In his free time, Fred loves sailing. He doesn't like playing football or basketball. He goes sailing every weekend.
structure.noteUz:
'love/like + fe'l-ING' → loves SAILING, like PLAYING.
INKORDA sanashda 'or' ishlatiladi.
'go sailing' = yelkanli qayiqda suzgani bormoq.

structure.modelEn: "I have got a great job and I feel very satisfied with my life," says Fred.
structure.noteUz:
Rejadagi iqtibos aynan ko'chiriladi.
'satisfied WITH' = ...dan mamnun (60-betdagi 3-mashqda ham bor edi).

structure.modelEn: Fred King, 38, is a reporter. "I like my job very much because I love interviewing people. It is tiring, though, because I work long hours," he says. Fred gets up at seven o'clock. He has a shower and gets dressed. He leaves home at eight o'clock and arrives at the office at half past eight. Then he reads the morning newspapers. He has lunch at half past twelve. In the afternoon, he writes articles and prepares for his TV programme. His TV programme finishes at six o'clock, then he meets his friends and has dinner. In the evening, he usually watches TV or listens to music. In his free time, Fred loves sailing. He doesn't like playing football or basketball. He goes sailing every weekend. "I have got a great job and I feel very satisfied with my life," says Fred.
structure.noteUz:
To'rt xatboshi, taxminan 130 so'z —
8-mashqdagi Sara haqidagi maqola bilan bir xil tuzilish.
BUTUN MATN PRESENT SIMPLE'DA (kundalik tartib).

wordFormation.introUz: 61-bet — kun tartibi fe'llari va ish bilan bog'liq so'zlar.

groups.explanationUz: Maqolada ega 'he/she' bo'lgani uchun hamma fe'l -s oladi.
Sport va hordiq mashg'ulotlari 'go' bilan aytiladi.
Ikkalasi ham chastota ravishlari, lekin turli gaplarda.

patterns.exampleEn: Where do they live? What can they do? Have they got small fins?
patterns.exampleUz: Ular qayerda yashaydi? Ular nima qila oladi? Ularning kichik suzgichlari bormi?

patterns.exampleEn: Sarah Miles, 25, is a cook. Fred King, 38, is a reporter.
patterns.exampleUz: Sara Maylz, 25 yoshda, oshpaz. Fred King, 38 yoshda, muxbir.
patterns.explanationUz:
Yosh VERGULLAR orasida beriladi.
Kasb oldida A/AN SHART.

patterns.formula: It is tiring, THOUGH, because/as I work long hours.
patterns.exampleEn: It is tiring, though, as I work from ten o'clock until eight every day.
patterns.exampleUz: Lekin bu charchatadigan ish, chunki men har kuni 10 dan 8 gacha ishlayman.

patterns.formula: In her/his free time, X + fe'l-S.
patterns.exampleEn: In her free time, Sarah visits her parents or goes fishing.
patterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtida Sara ota-onasinikiga boradi yoki baliq ovlaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'in his/her free time' — gap BOSHIDA, vergul bilan.

patterns.formula: I feel very happy/satisfied WITH + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: I feel very happy with the way I live. I feel very satisfied with my life.
patterns.exampleUz: Men yashash tarzimdan juda mamnunman. Men hayotimdan juda mamnunman.

patterns.exampleEn: "I've got a great job," says Sarah.
patterns.explanationUz:
Iqtibosdan keyin 'says + ism' tartibida yoziladi
(gazeta va maqolalarda odatiy).
